splitRule: Whole session IDs, disjoint parameter strings and layout seeds. Policy sees only pre-action observations. Audit evaluator is separate.
track: resettable live browser fixture, structured controls plus scoped image features
benefitCriterion: Paired mean success improvement over initialized OR fewer observations with success noninferiority margin 0.02. Fixed selector reported independently. Do not require superiority over fixed selector.
uncertainty: Wilson 95% success intervals and paired session bootstrap 95% delta intervals, seed 90210, 2000 resamples
promotion: zero false success; schema/security regression suite passes; lower 95% bound of success delta > 0 OR upper 95% bound of observation delta < 0 and lower success bound >= -0.02

gates.A: clean install, SDK/API/console, persistence/restart, schema rejection, offline operation, repeated setup
gates.B: interactive host identity, real capture, disposable native input and independently checked effects, cleanup
gates.C: local language compiler and actual native editor/calculator/Paint tasks, browser sourced output
gates.D: adversarial reliability, multi-demonstration compilation, unseen inputs, transfer, discovery, rollback
gates.E: 3-seed paired 100-episode resettable comparison, actual training and deployed inference
gates.F: client/bridge contracts, OSWorld/WindowsAgentArena adapters/smokes, moving target, remote/Telegram when available
